The '''Sullustan Home Guard''' was a [[Navy/Legends|starfleet]] maintained by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to defend [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. Its fleet of old [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] and [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] was initially crewed by members of the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] merchant marine, but received a professional full-time complement after enough time had passed to train them. It was commanded by the [[Home Guard Commodore]].

Initially formed to defend against [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] raids, it was created after [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY's]] [[Corporate Proclamation 137d]], under which SoroSuub took control of the planet Sullust and aligned the planet with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. When a local [[Sullustan Resistance|resistance movement]] began using guerrilla tactics against SoroSuub, the Home Guard was retooled to combat the rebellion, but the number of resistance supports in the Home Guard ranks proved a major obstacle.

The opportune arrival of an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class destroyer]] during one of the guerrilla attacks shifted the field of battle and [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb's]] personal ship, ''[[Sublight Queen]]'', was destroyed. Although Nunb himself survived the defeat, many resistance fighters scattered from the system and reformed under the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] banner.

With the support of the Rebel Alliance, the Home Guard proved ineffective against the Sullustan resistance. Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], SoroSuub voted to support the Rebellion, and a segment of the Home Guard under senior officer [[Syub Snunb]] fought in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Endor conflict]].
